svg.title: pdf-cpu-bench: The best PDF parser for RAG, without a GPU.
svg.desc: A newspaper clipping. BENCHMARK. The best PDF parser for RAG, without a GPU. 9 PDF-to-Markdown parsers on a plain 4-core CPU: olmocr-bench accuracy on 1,403 PDFs, seconds per page, peak RAM and install size. MinerU's CPU tier leads at 74.6%. benchmark and results on GitHub.
